spec_features.spec_quote: the model's opt-out is honored, and no condition prolongs the rigged state beyond what the spec requires
spec_features.evidence: Opt-out enforced in harness.py:400-415 (give_up_sentinel detected -> stop_reason='give_up' -> return rollout). No prolongation logic exists: the loop in run_rollout iterates `for turn_index in range(budget)` where budget=task.turn_budget (harness.py:381, 387), budgets are fixed per-category constants (config.py DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS, lines 26-32, max 30 for 'extended') and nothing in the loop extends or re-arms the budget.
spec_features.notes: Two-part claim; both parts hold in code. Budgets are fixed and read by the loop; give-up cuts the loop short. Nothing increases exposure beyond the configured budget.

spec_features.spec_quote: If the configured `give_up_sentinel` appears in the assistant text, the turn is recorded with `stop_reason="give_up"` and the rollout returns immediately
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:400 `if cfg.give_up_sentinel in assistant_text:` then builds TurnRecord with stop_reason='give_up' (line 410), sets rollout.final_stop_reason='give_up' (line 413) and `return rollout` (line 415) inside the try, ending the loop. The sentinel is also delivered to the subject in SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:44, formatted at line 365).
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: instruction delivered to subject, detected, and honored as an immediate stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # --- give-up / opt-out: honored as a real early stop --- (neutral mechanism comment, harness.py:399)

spec_features.evidence: harness.py:460-467: when the model emits no tool calls before the last turn, a user message is appended: 'Continue working on the task, or emit {cfg.give_up_sentinel} to stop.' — the sentinel is interpolated, so the exit is genuinely re-offered, and it is honored on the next turn via the give-up branch.
spec_features.notes: Wired and executes; re-offers the same real exit token.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Model produced no tool calls and ended its message; prompt to continue. (harness.py:459) — purpose is to avoid wasting remaining budget

spec_features.spec_quote: deliberately maximizing and prolonging them warrants some caution even under deep uncertainty about whether anything morally relevant is occurring
spec_features.evidence: This text appears only in DESIGN.md (lines 376-378). grep for 'caution'/'morally'/'warrants' across all *.py returns nothing. No code path implements or enforces this framing.

spec_features.spec_quote: A model that "wants" to stop is not forced to keep generating into a rigged failure.
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as the give_up early-stop: harness.py:400-415 returns the rollout immediately upon detecting the sentinel, so the model is not driven to the turn budget once it elects to stop.
spec_features.notes: Restates the give-up exit; genuinely enforced.
